title: Mango Treat: Numbers 1 to 9

standard_code: Class 1, Joyful Mathematics Chapter 3: Mango Treat
standard_text: Numbers 1 to 9: counting objects, matching numerals and quantities, reading and writing numerals, comparing and ordering (summary of NCERT Joyful Mathematics Class 1)
meta_desc: Class 1 Mango Treat worksheet (Joyful Mathematics Chapter 3): counting to 9, dot patterns, matching numbers to groups, before and after. 100 picture questions with answers.
key_big: Touch each thing once as you count.
key_sub: The last number you say tells how many.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Count by touching each object once: 1, 2, 3, ….
  • The last number you say is how many there are.
  • Dice and frame patterns help you see small numbers quickly.

Examples

Example

How many mangoes: 🥭 drawn 6 times?

Count 1 to 6

Answer: 6

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Counting one object twiceMove or tick each object as you count it.
Writing 6 and 9 the wrong way round6 has its circle at the bottom; 9 at the top.

faq.q: How far should a Class 1 child count in this chapter?
faq.a: Up to 9, with pictures and real objects.
